sloka: येन सप्त महा साला गिरिर् भूमिः च दारिताः ।बाणेन एकेन काकुत्स्थ स्थाता ते को रण अग्रतः ॥४-१२-९॥
transliteration: yena sapta mahā sālā girir bhūmiḥ ca dāritāḥ ।bāṇena ekena kākutstha sthātā te ko raṇa agrataḥ ॥4-12-9॥

translations.english: 'O Rama who can in a battle confront you, capable of splitting seven huge sala trees, the mountain and the earth with a single arrow?
